The main takeaway from our work is that
the computational geometry methods can be used to solve a variety of algorithmic problems that are of interest in computer graphics and other areas of computer science as well.

some methods from computational geometry, such as the convex hull, the Voronoi diagram, and the arrangement of lines, are very useful in the design of efficient algorithms for problems in computer graphics.
